a.lede: A homelab builder runs Qwen 3.6 35B on three used Nvidia Tesla V100 GPUs at about 100 tokens per second, in a $1,042 build.
a.title: Three 'e-waste' Nvidia V100s hit 100 tokens per second on Qwen 3.6 35B in a $1,042 homelab rig

b.lede: A Reddit homelabber’s Optane PMem 200 server now runs Moonshot AI’s Kimi K3 at 3.11 tokens/s with two RTX 3090s and a RAM drive.
b.title: Homelabber’s second-gen Optane build uses two RTX 3090s to run 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi AI model at 3.11 tokens per second
